senses.gloss: f.(b. h., בָּהַר)bright white spot on the skin, eventually one of the symptoms of leprosy.
units: Neg. I, 1 ב׳ עזה כשלג bahereth means an intensively bright spot (sparkling) like snow.

<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 2:1">Ib. II, 1</cite> <he>ב׳ עזה וכ׳</he> an intensely bright spot appears faint on the skin of a Germanus (Teuton), and the faint spot appears bright on a Cushite; (Sifra Thazr., <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 1:1">Neg. ch. I</cite>, ed. Weiss <he>כג׳</he>, <cite ref="K00250"><he>ככ׳</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 551:19">Yalk. Lev. 551</cite> <he>גרדמ׳</he>, corr. <he>בגרמ׳</he>, <he>בכושי</he>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>בֶּהָרוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 8:6">Ib. VIII, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 3:12">Tosef. ib. III, 12</cite>.
